slices: **Entry + four steps** — compact intro, numbered guide, context → names → draft → apply
**Name radios** — no preselection; both undecided, one undecided, four include/omit combinations
**Draft recovery** — fixture_missing, pending choice-change (cancel then confirm), preview valid/invalid
**Apply / undo / outcome** — enabled vs disabled Apply, empty vs nonempty undo stack, applied vs kept
**Live last** — closed by default; unavailable-unverified / pending / complete / failed / timed_out / stopped / no_result do not block core
